description: Omen of Clarity Requires Druid Requires level 20 Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources. (10s cooldown)
name: Omen of Clarity
